entries.title: Why HN is slow lately
entries.author: pg
entries.excerpt: We've had a huge spike in traffic lately, from roughly 24k daily uniques to 33k. This is a result of being mentioned on more mainstream sites. I hope this spike will subside, like past ones have. In the meantime I may temporarily hack a few things to make the site faster, like putting fewer results on threads pages. entries.guide_zh: HN 因日访问人数大涨而变慢，站方说明临时应对措施。

entries.title: What caused that outage
entries.author: pg
entries.excerpt: HN was down today for around 2 hours. Sorry about that. The News server currently crashes a couple times a day when it runs out of memory. All the comments and stories no longer fit in the 2 GB we can get on a 32 bit machine. We'd been planning to upgrade to a new 64 bit server. In the meantime it was arguably a rather slow form of GC. Unfortunately the process somehow got wedged in the middle of segfaulting. We're not sure why and will probably never know. But that meant the
entries.guide_zh: 作者解释 HN 约两小时的宕机，称服务器遇到内存容量限制。

entries.title: Ask YC:  Anyone actually making money selling ebooks/digital goods?
entries.author: iamelgringo
entries.current_title: Ask YC:  Anyone actually making money selling ebooks/digital goods?
entries.excerpt: So, this article seems to have gotten traction on HN: http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=516215 It's not a new idea. Tim Ferris has been preaching that since the Four Hour Work Week was published, and affiliate marketing programs are clearing houses for people doing this sort of thing. Is anyone on HN doing this, or have you done it in the past. I'd love to hear some anecdotes from this community.
entries.guide_zh: 卖电子书等数字商品真的能赚钱么，邀请有收入经验的人现身说法。

entries.title: Ask HN: How many of you (coders) use marijuana?
entries.author: jgalvez
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How many of you (coders) use marijuana?
entries.excerpt: With the recent public talk and growing awareness about marijuana and the failed policies against it, it occurred to me it would be interesting to get an idea of how many fellow programmers use marijuana and how it affects their work. I find it specially positive in my work, as an aid to better concentration and also greater creativity.
entries.guide_zh: 询问程序员使用大麻的情况，以及它如何影响工作与生活。
